clips.title: The story
paras: A Lack of Virtue is a delivery quest involving an enduring petty grudge between two card-playing sailors, Tom Half-fish and Bart Tidewater. Travelers carry a packaged gift across the sea to Menethil Harbor, stepping right into the middle of a mutual cheating accusation over how the Maiden's Virtue was won.

A Lack of Virtue centers on an acrimonious rivalry between two salty seafaring gamblers: Tom Half-fish and Bart Tidewater. Tom recruits passing travelers to deliver a packaged parcel across the water to Bart in Menethil Harbor, using the delivery as a petty spiteful jab against his former companion. Along the way, Tom warns that Bart is no true sea dog at all, but rather a former actor who cheated his way through card games to purchase his command.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!
"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!
If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.
There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!
Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Why that no good, son of a--
Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!
I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--
I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
